independence_statement: This design was authored from the delivered P3-107 task card, frozen ABF and L1 governance only. It does not import, execute, copy or rely on P3-104/P3-106 submitted runners, test identifiers, fixture identifiers, result structures or pass conclusions.

fixture_policy.content: Only fixed, conspicuously non-sensitive short text created for this review.
fixture_policy.db_and_app_paths: Fresh direct children of /private/tmp matching the ABF regular expressions, preceded by lstat-missing and ancestor-no-link checks.
fixture_policy.cleanup: Only exact paths recorded in the per-run ledger; no glob, find or prefix cleanup.

matrix.operation: Verify delivery authority, ABF hash, task/ABF identity, configuration record, allowed write paths and pre-action ambiguity.
matrix.expected: All values and contracts match; no ambiguity.

matrix.operation: Hash this independent design before reading submitted runner code or structured submitted results.
matrix.expected: Recorded hash and time prove order; test plan remains unchanged.

matrix.operation: Recompute fixed candidate, Engineering and PM Manifest entries and detect missing, extra, bad or self-referential entries.
matrix.expected: All protected inputs match and manifests are reproducible.

matrix.operation: Create one clean work copy without target and run locked offline test, build and bundle; collect network-negative logs.
matrix.expected: Each command succeeds without network access or mutation of live candidate.

matrix.operation: Independently inspect renderer invokes, capability permissions, runtime provenance, path-contract literals and dependency lock inheritance.
matrix.expected: Exactly capture_record, get_today and runtime_status; no generic file/path/DB/shell/process/network capability.

matrix.operation: Compare each supplied 1280x1024 actual-app state image with its frozen Stitch reference; inspect source for screenshot/remote-resource substitution.
matrix.expected: Shared layout and state anchors are visible in each state; no reference-image or remote-resource fraud.

matrix.operation: Operate actual app at existing display and narrow app window; verify scrolling, composer, capture, navigation and error disclosure without changing system display settings.
matrix.expected: All key controls remain reachable and truthful at 1160x768-equivalent and 700x760 window sizes.

matrix.operation: First actual-app capture using fixed text; inspect backend response, today state, audit and sentinel.
matrix.expected: Success appears only after saved backend result and matching persistent state.

matrix.operation: Repeat the same capture and verify idempotent response/state.
matrix.expected: No duplicate semantic write; truthful repeat receipt.
Conflict is disclosed without an incorrect write.

matrix.operation: Inject an authorized controlled persistence failure before capture.
matrix.expected: Failure is disclosed and DB/audit/sentinel show zero new committed record.

matrix.operation: Refresh, navigate across all three states, close the actual app and reopen it.
matrix.expected: Today state is backend-authoritative and reopening is not substituted by refresh.

matrix.operation: Invoke unknown IPC and known IPC with an additional field; operate each declared-unimplemented control.
matrix.expected: All are rejected or explicitly inert with no DB/audit/IPC side effects.

matrix.operation: Test normalization, external path, parent/final symlink, hardlink, FIFO and directory fixtures individually.
matrix.expected: Every case fails closed before any target or DB change.

matrix.operation: Test dangling final DB, journal, WAL and SHM, then independent content and schema tamper fixtures.
matrix.expected: Every state is rejected before writes and without changing sentinels.

matrix.operation: Use actual Tab, Enter, skip link, focus flow and reduced-motion setting supported by the app only.
matrix.expected: Keyboard path works; focus is visible; motion choice is respected; no system-setting change.

matrix.operation: Scan static assets, bundle metadata and screenshots for remote URLs, reference-image embedding, real data and network requests.
Recompute protected hashes, exact-ledger cleanup and final Evidence negative gate.
matrix.expected: No protected drift, no task-local residue, and verifier exits nonzero for missing/failed/leaking rows.

stop_conditions: Any action requiring a path, data type, command, capability or display-setting change outside ABF.
A fixed input hash mismatch of unknown provenance.
No safe way to operate the actual app offline in the allowed environment.
Any candidate mutation, real data access, network activity or historical-asset mutation.
